channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
python_min:
- '3.11'

about.description:
ngxparse is a maintained fork of NGINX's crossplane library that
parses an nginx configuration file into a JSON-friendly AST and
pretty-prints an AST back to a valid nginx configuration. It
incorporates bug fixes and improvements not present in the
original (now unmaintained) upstream and is the parsing engine
behind the gixy nginx static analyzer.
about.summary: Reliable and fast NGINX configuration file parser

name: ngxparse
raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  version: "0.5.16"

package:
  name: ngxparse
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/n/ngxparse/ngxparse-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 33746d1693d93903ab0c2b37ba16b8a4743a2767b1959dc125a2417d253b7e3b

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
  python:
    entry_points:
      - crossplane = crossplane.__main__:main

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - pip
    - setuptools
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
  run_constraints:
    # ngxparse is a drop-in fork and ships its importable module and console
    # script as `crossplane`, so it installs the same files as the `crossplane`
    # package. The two cannot coexist in one prefix.
    - crossplane <0a0

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        # ngxparse ships its importable module as `crossplane` (drop-in fork).
        - crossplane
      pip_check: true
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}.*
        - "*"
  - script:
      - crossplane --help
    requirements:
      run:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/dvershinin/crossplane
  repository: https://github.com/dvershinin/crossplane
  summary: Reliable and fast NGINX configuration file parser
  description: |
    ngxparse is a maintained fork of NGINX's crossplane library that
    parses an nginx configuration file into a JSON-friendly AST and
    pretty-prints an AST back to a valid nginx configuration. It
    incorporates bug fixes and improvements not present in the
    original (now unmaintained) upstream and is the parsing engine
    behind the gixy nginx static analyzer.
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file: LICENSE

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - dvershinin
